mat_coordinates: X=center x, Y=bottom y, one-based pixel origin

gpu_memory.scope: PyTorch CUDA allocator for this process, measured after warm-up. Includes resident model tensors; excludes other processes, driver allocations and non-PyTorch CUDA allocations. CPU runs report null.

measurement_notes.backend_forward: Ultralytics-reported model forward only. Equivalent FPS is not end-to-end throughput.
measurement_notes.predict_call: Synchronized wall time for model.predict, including preprocessing, transfers, forward and postprocessing. Disk read and final CPU box copy excluded.
measurement_notes.frame: Synchronized wall time from disk read/decode through prediction and CPU box copy. Excludes metric matching, AP, output writing and plotting. OS disk cache may be warm.
measurement_notes.evaluation_loop: Includes frame processing plus Python annotation/matching/collection and progress printing. Excludes warm-up, annotation loading, model loading, final AP and output files.
measurement_notes.comparison: Serial batch-1 measurement with per-frame synchronization. Use matching hardware, inputs and settings. Temporal capture/buffering delay is not measured.

note: All gtInfo vehicles evaluated against merged YOLO car/bus/truck. Ignore regions not applied. COCO-style AP; fixed-threshold F1 uses confidence-ordered matching. TN/accuracy undefined for object detection. Timing excludes warm-up; see systems_metrics.json for scopes; not an official UA-DETRAC benchmark score.
